acceptance.given: The compiler is invoked for the frozen Package A requirements and emits a semantic plan artifact.

oracle.expected: The emitted plan contains one independently traceable Acceptance, oracle, assertion set, source reference, and failure intent for every required behavior, with no independent behaviors collapsed or omitted.
forbidden: Any required behavior is absent from the emitted compiler output.
Independent behaviors are represented only by a shared collapsed Acceptance, oracle, assertions, source references, or failure intent when separate material is required.
oracle.observable: The compiler output can be structurally inspected to map each required behavior to its own Acceptance, oracle, assertion IDs, source reference, and failure intent.

acceptance.then: The compiled semantic plan records complete, individually traceable acceptance material for every required behavior.
acceptance.when: After compilation, inspect the emitted semantic plan and reconcile its behavior entries against the frozen requirement sections.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A deterministic compiler-output validation selector detects an omitted behavior or a behavior whose Acceptance, oracle, assertions, source reference, or failure intent is missing or incorrectly collapsed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure semantic-plan compilation emits independently traceable acceptance material for every frozen required behavior and rejects incomplete or collapsed coverage.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Compiler output remains schema-compatible; reverting restores prior compilation behavior without changing runtime or persisted state.

slice_hint.state_transition: Frozen requirements input -> compiled semantic plan with complete per-behavior traceability.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A deterministic compiler-output check maps every frozen required behavior to exactly one complete Acceptance, oracle, assertion set, source reference, and failure intent, and reports failure for omissions or collapsed independent behaviors.
